marks.label: Local desk, borrower role bound to a Grofty TestNet wallet: its commands need that wallet's signature
Connect: the dapp-sdk picker finds the Grofty extension
Grofty asks to connect the desk
Connected on canton:da-testnet: the panel names the wallet party and the role it drives
Send request: the desk answers with a challenge naming the exact command; Grofty signs it
Signature checked (key fingerprint = party namespace), RepoRFQ created, receipt listed
Verify signature: the desk re-checks it without trusting the browser
Take this quote: the award is a second command, signed again in Grofty
Award executed on the desk ledger with the wallet's signature
Pay the venue fee: 1 CC on Canton TestNet, prepared by the desk, executed by Grofty
Paid on TestNet: the wallet returns the update id

notes: Signed commands: the desk answered 401 with a challenge naming the exact command; Grofty showed it in its Signature Request and returned an Ed25519 signature; the desk checked nonce, signer, signature and that the key fingerprint equals the party namespace before submitting. hostedWalletVerify is https://talang-desk.vercel.app/api/wallet-verify re-checking each receipt; the tampered check appends one space to the message.

Payment recipient: grofty-qa-testnet is the party that funded this wallet with 100 CC (memo "bansos", 2026-10-09); it stands in for a venue party. The wallet itself could not be the recipient: an earlier attempt in this session to pay talang-venue from talang-venue was refused by Grofty with "-32603 Sender and receiver cannot be the same party". A second wallet in the same Grofty account was refused on 2026-10-09: "Creating or importing another wallet is blocked for this email".

An exploratory payment earlier in the same session, same flow and recipient, also executed on TestNet: 1 CC, update id 122005be86fdff5048795958ea2eae9876d2c41a48603ba22c695b58caa6c60753eb (the "Sent 06:59 PM" line in walletActivity).

TestNet Scan (scan.sv-1.test..., scan.sv-2.test...) answered 403 / RBAC denied from this machine, so the TestNet update ids are as returned by the wallet (status "executed") and shown in its activity list; no public explorer link.
Times in walletActivity are the machine local time (UTC+7).
